name: 07722 · Colts Neck, NJ
findings: ZIP 07722 (Colts Neck) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07722 (Colts Neck) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
